title: Smooth fibrewise tensor bundle
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real manifold [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], and let $B,C\to N$ be smooth real vector bundles of finite ranks $b,c$ [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. On the set $T=\coprod_{x\in N}(B_x\otimes_{\mathbf R}C_x)$ with projection $(x,t)\mapsto x$, the fibre tensor product is the quotient by the bilinearity relations [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Use a common refinement $(U_i)$ of the trivializing covers of $B,C$, with fibre coordinate maps $\phi_{i,x}:B_x\to\mathbf R^b$ and $\psi_{i,x}:C_x\to\mathbf R^c$. The tensor pretrivialization is $\tau_i(x,v\otimes w)=(x,\phi_{i,x}(v)\otimes\psi_{i,x}(w))$, extended linearly. Identify its model $\mathbf R^b\otimes\mathbf R^c$ with $\mathbf R^{bc}$ by sending $e_a\otimes f_d$ to the coordinate vector indexed by $(a,d)$. Define the topology on $T$ by declaring $O\subseteq T$ open precisely when $\tau_i(O\cap T|_{U_i})$ is open in $U_i\times\mathbf R^{bc}$ for every $i$. Give each fibre $B_x\otimes_{\mathbf R}C_x$ the topology pulled back from $\mathbf R^{bc}$ along the fibre map of $\tau_i$ for some $i$ with $x\in U_i$; it does not depend on $i$, since two such fibre maps differ by the invertible matrix $g_{ji}(x)\otimes h_{ji}(x)$ described below, so every fibre map of every $\tau_i$ is inducing. For every $x\in N$ select one index $i(x)$ with $x\in U_{i(x)}$. Give $T\to N$ the smooth bundle atlas determined by these pretrivializations, using the smooth-prebundle realization [lem-sfb-smooth-vector-prebundle-realization]. This is the smooth fibrewise tensor bundle $B\otimes_{\mathbf R}C$. If the respective coordinate changes are $g_{ji}(x)$ and $h_{ji}(x)$, its tensor coordinate change is $g_{ji}(x)\otimes h_{ji}(x)$; the matrix entry with row $(a,d)$ and column $(k,l)$ is $g_{ji,ak}(x)h_{ji,dl}(x)$.
